steps.title: Front seal bead ring B (cast silicone) stretched over the core into the front groove
O-ring 2.0 x 0.7 stretched over the spigot into the face groove of the end cap
Silicone sheet gasket laid into the 0.4 mm recess of the end cap
Septum disc d3.2 x 2 dropped into the septum pocket (open top)
End cap lid lowered on the lands (clamp screws follow once the module sits in the pod)
Plunger (core + front bead) pushed into the reservoir from the open dry end
Fluid module (cap sandwich with O-ring) pressed onto the reservoir end: spigot into the port, O-ring on the end face
Dry bush pressed into the bearing-block bore (reamed d3.05)
FPC spine laid into the floor channel (it passes UNDER the reservoir; riser at the contact shelf)
Motor (rear boss, motor, gearbox, front boss, shaft, terminal block + pins) laid into the three saddles, terminal pins facing +Y
Gear A (z16) slid onto the motor shaft from the front and glued
Thrust sleeve (brass tube) glued into the nut gear
Diametric ring magnet pushed over the rear end of the sleeve and glued (pole direction marked)
M1.6 nut glued (Loctite 638) on the front face of the nut gear
Nut-gear pack lowered into the bearing block, meshing with gear A
Reservoir sub-assembly lowered and slid 1.2 mm toward -X over the nut (the nut protrudes into the bore opening)
Needle + hub pressed into the guard tube from the dock mouth
Drive screw (the only rod) inserted from the REAR through the rear-wall hole, turned through the nut with a pin vise until the slot meets the plunger tab
Silicone stopper pressed into the rear-wall hole
USB-C gasket frame laid against the inside of the rear wall
Waterproof USB-C receptacle pushed to the rear wall (nose through the opening, flange on the gasket)
USB board dropped behind the receptacle
SENSOR board with the TMAG5273 lowered onto three posts / pins beside the ring magnet
Motor contact card (4 SMD spring contacts) lowered into its slot, springs wipe onto the motor pin tips
Li-Po cell on 0.6 mm foam tape, tabs up, between the two bay ribs
Dock insert slid into the dock window from the +X mouth until the detents click (before the board: the dock hall chip hangs below it)
MAIN board (radio, button, dock hall, 2 cell springs, 8 spine springs) lowered onto the pins
Main gasket laid on the wall top
Piezo glued to the lid inner face (ePTFE vent disc and PU film glued into their recesses)
Clear lid with piezo lowered straight down
Dock magnet d2 x 1 glued into the rear lug pocket of the dummy head
Dock: dummy head pushed into the pod mouth, snap arms spread and latch behind the dome
